up: List all approved drugs indicated for lymphoma. For each drug, return the following details: ChEMBL ID, molecule name, canonical SMILES (structure), indication label (e.g., MeSH heading), and EFO term for the indication. Include only drugs with max_phase = 4.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN atc_classification atc ON md.molregno = atc.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (di.mesh_heading LIKE '%lymphoma%' OR di.efo_term LIKE '%lymphoma%')
